title: WS7: /glw jetpack give resolves and the gadget module boots with the WS7-D4 Bartizan trait bridge active (Bartizan present) -- console can only confirm the module loads, the command resolves without an error/exception, and the Bartizan item-vocabulary/trait registration lines appear; it CANNOT drive an actual equip or verify flight (no in-game player exists in a console-only run) -- same documented-gap shape as S1's '/glw help lists only core commands' and S4's 'detainment table migrates', see README.md Limitations. A human with a real client must equip the given jetpack and confirm it actually flies; JetpackNbtIdentityTest/JetpackServiceActivatePermissionTest are the automated unit-level equivalent for the parts console can't reach.

WS7 G4: a chestplate carrying only the old Bartizan 'wearable' tag is re-stamped with the jetpack tag on next equip, keeps its fuel, and can then refuel/fly (JetpackService.migrateLegacyJetpack) -- console CANNOT inject a pre-tagged legacy item into a player's inventory or drive an equip event at all (no in-game player, no 'give player NBT' console command), so this row can only confirm the gadget module boots clean with items/jetpacks.yml loaded and the Bartizan trait bridge active; the migration behaviour itself (JETPACK_ID stamped, fuel preserved not reset, then refuels and flies) needs a human tester with a real client and a hand-crafted pre-0.9.2 test item, OR is covered at the unit level by JetpackLegacyMigrationTest (red-first, asserts FUEL_CURRENT survives unchanged). Documented gap, not a silent boolean -- same shape as jetpack-give's above.

WS7 G5/G5b: all six modules, Bartizan REMOVED -- supersedes D6 (legacy). gadget (G5) and civilians (G5b) both dropped their hard Plugins:[Bartizan] module.yml edge, so both now load without Bartizan; turf loads too (Depends:[civilians] only, no direct Bartizan edge of its own -- it was only ever transitively blocked by civilians requiring Bartizan, and that block is gone now that civilians is soft). cops-n-crooks keeps Plugins:[Bartizan] unchanged (explicitly out of WS7 scope) and is the only module skipped, with module.plugin.missing. mail and npcshops load regardless, as always (neither ever had a Bartizan or civilians edge).

WS7 G5 fix round 1 (I3): gadget module boots with Bartizan PRESENT and drives /glw car commands (the G5 counterpart to jetpack-give, which only exercised jetpack commands) -- confirms CarWeaponDamageListener's condition="isBartizanAvailable" resolves true and the class registers cleanly when Bartizan IS installed (the flip side of ws7-no-bartizan, which already proved gadget boots fine WITHOUT it). Console can only confirm the module/listener wiring boots without an error/exception and the command resolves -- it CANNOT punch a car or verify actual weapon-vs-vanilla damage routing (no in-game player, same documented-gap shape as jetpack-give); CarMeleeWeaponLookupGuardTest/CarDamageListener's own unit tests are the automated equivalent for the parts console can't reach. A human with a real client punching a car (with and without a melee weapon held) is booked for G6's manual checklist.

WS7 G5 fix round 1 (I3/C2 verification): all six modules, Citizens PRESENT, Bartizan REMOVED -- attempts /glw civilian spawn gang_member (a Hostile:true, Weapon_Pool-bearing civilian type, npc/civilians.yml:85-99) from console. IMPORTANT DOCUMENTED GAP: CivilianSpawnCommand.typeIdArgument (and CivilianSpawnGroupCommand identically) both require `sender instanceof Player` and send Messages.NOT_PLAYER otherwise -- confirmed by direct source read before writing this row -- so console CANNOT actually force a spawn or drive BartizanNpcWeapons.create's weapon-assignment codepath (the actual C2 fix target); this row can only confirm the command resolves cleanly (no exception) when invoked from console, and that the whole topology boots clean with Citizens present and Bartizan absent (civilians/gadget/turf load, only cops-n-crooks faults). Verifying an actual hostile civilian spawn while Bartizan is absent (BartizanNpcWeapons.create/buildItem's C2 guard, live) needs a human tester with a real client standing where a civilian can spawn, or spawning one via /glw civilian spawn as an actual player -- booked for G6's manual checklist.
